text: Hey Paulina - yes you can go in person, however it might not make much of a difference in your case. From what I can see from your previous posts, you received your A5 just a few days ago. Usually it takes a few days (and sometimes even more) for the new ID number to be properly activated in PIBA's systems and then shared with other government agencies. If BL isn't able to recognise it online yet, then I'm not sure they will also be able recognise it when you visit a branch. I would recommend trying again online until it is recognised :)
